purpose: This table provides a cleaned registry of aircraft referenced by tail number, feeding downstream flight-analytics tables that join on tailnum to enrich flight records with aircraft manufacturer, model, engine configuration, and capacity details.
usage: Join on tailnum to attach aircraft attributes to flight-level facts; consumers must expect null year for about 2.1% of rows and should treat speed as present for less than 1% of rows (99.3% null), so any aggregate or filter on speed must explicitly account for its near-total sparsity rather than assuming coverage.
limitations: The cleanup dropped all three Airbyte capture-metadata columns since they carry no business meaning; speed is retained despite being populated in only 0.7% of rows (null_rate 0.993076), and year retains a 2.1% null rate (70 of 3322 rows) because no reliable inference source was available in this profile; no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no deduplication logic was applied.
